text:
Hannah K: Quick note — several reviewers in APAC flagged being offline during our calibration week. I'm proposing a 'weekend review batch' where reviewers can opt in to process late/non-comp forms up to 48h after the global cutoff. This would produce a Monday digest for calibration. Thoughts?
Leo W: Weekend batching makes sense operationally. Main worry: how do we ensure those weekend reviews feed into the Monday synchronous calibration conversation?
Aditi P: We can have People Ops compile a 1-page digest of weekend-reviewed forms with flags (outlier ratings, growth asks, possible comp flags) so calibrators can discuss them first thing Monday. That keeps the cadence without dragging reviewers into live calls.
Samir K: I support the idea but we should exclude any comp or promotion cases from the batch. Compensation decisions need to hit the live queue. Otherwise we risk delaying pay decisions.
Hannah K: Agreed. Proposal update: weekend batch allowed for non-comp and non-promotion forms only. People Ops to add a 'comp/promo flag' checkbox on the form; if checked the submission is routed to the live queue and excluded from weekend batching.
Juno (HR Bot): I can add a boolean field comp_promo_flag and an automated router: "live_queue" vs "weekend_batch". I can also auto-generate the Monday digest using the template: 1) total batch count, 2) list of outliers (ID + brief reason), 3) recommended next action. Will wait for People Ops to confirm activation.
Aditi P: Also recommend a 20-minute synchronous mini-training for weekend reviewers on Friday 08:30 PT to review the speed rubric and escalation paths. Short training dramatically improves consistency.
Hannah K: Action list: (1) People Ops enable weekend batch + comp_promo_flag, (2) schedule 20m training Fri 08:30 PT, (3) publish digest template and owner, (4) add an opt-out checkbox so reviewers not wanting weekend work won't be auto-assigned. I'll draft the announcement.
Leo W: Please include guidance on expected throughput per weekend reviewer (suggested cap = 6) and a quick triage checklist.
Hannah K: Will add cap of 6 by default, reviewers can set a higher limit if they opt in. Posting draft in 30m unless anyone objects.
Samir K: No objections from eng. Thanks for the plan. :thumbsup:
Juno (HR Bot): comp_promo_flag field created; router ready. Waiting on People Ops toggle to activate weekend_batch routing.
